findings.message: nested quantifiers: (…)+ repeats a group that already repeats 'a'+ — backtracking can be exponential
findings.suggestion: Avoid applying an unbounded quantifier to a group that itself repeats. Reduce to a single quantifier, bound the inner repetition ({1,100}), or use an atomic group / possessive quantifier where the engine supports it.
